canonical_statement: For parameters in the admissible Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg range, every compactly supported smooth function on Euclidean n-space satisfies the corresponding weighted L^r interpolation estimate between a weighted L^p norm of its gradient and a weighted L^q norm of the function, with a finite parameter-dependent constant.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: n : Nat with 1 <= n; real-valued compactly supported smooth functions on EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n); real exponents and weights. Exact norm codomains and universe parameters remain for statement freeze.
quantifiers: dimension n and admissible real parameters p, q, r, alpha, beta, gamma, a
a finite constant C depending on the admitted parameters
every compactly supported smooth test function u on R^n
hypotheses: the complete positivity, endpoint, weight, and interpolation restrictions of the primary CKN theorem
smoothness and compact support (with any source-required exclusion of the origin)
conclusion: The weighted L^r norm of u is at most C times the a-th power of the weighted L^p norm of its gradient times the (1-a)-th power of its weighted L^q norm.

alternate_encodings.target: integral-power formulation using explicit integrals instead of Lp norms
alternate_encodings.relationship: iff after finiteness and exponent side conditions

alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none; special cases cannot substitute for the root family

excluded_degenerate_cases: Undefined weighted norms, inadmissible endpoints, zero or invalid dimension, and singular-origin cases not covered by the primary theorem are excluded only after exact source transcription; no optimal constant or extremizer claim is included.
excluded_substitutions: an unweighted Sobolev or Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality
a theorem assuming the desired inequality as a field or hypothesis
later optimal-constant, extremizer, or symmetry-breaking results
